lines.l: Oh, yeah, yeah, your face is in the candlelight, I see you clearly now, your heart is in darkness, but I see what you feel.
Your mind is like a circle going round and around
You don't know where to go
No matter, no matter how long it takes
I'm not gonna try to make a thing
So you keep on going on
Said you keep on going on
I said your face is in the candlelight
Your heart is a dumb mess
But I see what you feel
I said your mind is like a circle going round and round
You don't know where to go
No matter, no matter how long it takes
I'm not going to change anything
I'm not going to try to make a thing
So you keep on going on
